command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/workspace/omega_runtime
C=$(readlink -f $R/current)
echo CURRENT=$C
echo '--- receipt_reconciler.log tail ---'
tail -n 160 $R/state/logs/receipt_reconciler.log 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- py_compile ---'
PYTHONPATH=$C python3 -m py_compile $C/omega/spool_receipt_reconciler.py $C/omega/receipt_reconciler.py $C/omega/unified_store.py && echo COMPILE_OK
echo '--- module import ---'
PYTHONPATH=$C python3 - <<'PY'
import omega.spool_receipt_reconciler as m
print('IMPORT_OK', m.__file__)
PY
echo '--- supervisor child snapshot ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
print(json.dumps(d.get('children',{}).get('receipt_reconciler',{}),sort_keys=True))
PY
